# Original rain fixture

`rubberduck-rain.original.ogg` is the unconverted `rain.ogg` member of
rubberduck's [30 CC0 SFX loops](https://opengameart.org/content/30-cc0-sfx-loops),
published under [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).
It is 189015 bytes, SHA-256
`8d153f3f6ee266484f679d7149c80a1afcf4dcfeb9f2c1b6206ed780a12273fb`.

Original ZIP SHA-256:
`9c013474c7e56192a0d1b2840535a1e1d8b93166948d4a9f7136bb6c3d5421cd`.
The author page declares the licence; the original ZIP has no licence member.
The response fixture records that external witness explicitly. It does not
fabricate a file in the original archive, attribute it to Kenney, or claim
hearing, loop, author-use or commercial-quality approval.

Original page/official CC0 reference/ZIP and all reviewed hashes are retained
separately during source verification. Protocol tests use controlled HTTP;
an OGG fixture and a response are not producer/author or native decoder proof.
